Quarantine Tombstone File Template Resource Get Qtn Tombstone File Templates
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/quarantineTombstoneTemplate/lite

Retrieves the templates for the tombstone file created when a file is quarantined. .

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Tombstone file template ID

name
string
REQUIRED

Tombstone file template name

description
string
REQUIRED

The text that is included in the tombstone file

]
